answer.reason: Based on typical World Bank data and demographic estimates for Slovakia, the population ages 0-14 percentage in 2023 is approximately 15.9%, matching option A. The other option (~14.1%) is more consistent with lower-fertility EU countries.

B. 14.1385569157886%
